data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin that enables synchronous and asynchronous JavaScript‑Dart communication via a WebView bridge.
data.what_it_does: It wraps webview_flutter and adds a JavaScript bridge allowing Dart code to expose functions to JavaScript and call JavaScript functions. Supports sync, async, progress callbacks, namespaces and debug mode.
use_when: You need tight two‑way interaction between a WebView's JavaScript and Flutter code
You want to reuse existing dsbridge.js code without rewriting it
You require progress callbacks or modal dialogs from JavaScript
avoid_when: You only need to display static web content without native interaction
You prefer a pure Dart‑only solution without a WebView
strengths: Full‑duplex bridge with sync and async calls
Namespace support for large API sets
Progress callbacks and built‑in JavaScript dialogs
weaknesses: Depends on webview_flutter, so inherits its platform limitations
Adds extra layer of complexity compared to direct JavaScript injection

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a basic WebView without the extra bridge layer, suitable if you don't need JavaScript‑Dart communication
